message: 魔王の資質

name: Melilot
message: 「It will be difficult」
Melilot returned a book to the shelf just as she always did, speaking in her usual cool voice.

name: Synn
message: 「...Is that so」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hold on. Can't Azel suppress Re-Crea's power to some extent?」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, no matter how extraordinarily large Azel's vessel of Spirit Power may be, he is still not a god」

name: Melilot
message: 「Completely suppressing Re-Crea once it reaches criticality would be quite difficult」

name: Synn
message: 「Making the impossible possible is what the Student Council does!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Had we realized sooner that he was the vessel for Re-Crea, there might have been a way」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of way?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is merely crying over spilt milk now and only theoretically possible, though」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel is not a god」

name: Melilot
message: 「Since divine power has been poured into him, you can see how unnatural and unstable that state is, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes」

name: Melilot
message: 「Anything forcibly pieced together comes apart easily」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if it comes apart easily, I likely could not have done it alone」

name: Synn
message: 「And if it came apart?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Beings with the capacity to house Re-Crea are rare in both Heaven and the Demon World. It is no exaggeration to say they are practically nonexistent」

name: Paqy
message: 「So basically, you're saying it'd have nowhere to stay and vanish?」
Melilot nodded.

name: Melilot
message: 「Had that happened, just like with a usual Re-Crea, we would have only needed to resolve Re-Crea as a natural phenomenon and its accompanying issues」

name: Synn
message: 「Has Re-Crea ever resided inside someone before?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Upon re-examining the records, I confirmed that aside from the Demon Lord, beings with abnormal power have appeared alongside Re-Crea several times」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though none appeared to be as powerful as Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... that the Demon Lord defeated them?」
Paqy might have known.
Perhaps there had been a Demon Lord and a Re-Crea just like me and Azel.
Maybe that's the exact reason he didn't tell me.

name: Melilot
message: 「As far as I could confirm, there were only a few such cases. It seems the vast majority vanished before anyone knew it」

name: Synn
message: 「Before anyone knew it... you say?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Judging from the cases where records of their final moments remain, their vessels likely couldn't withstand Re-Crea's power and self-destructed」

name: Melilot
message: 「According to the records, they melted from the inside out while emitting a seven-colored light at the end」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, there were guys like that」

name: Melilot
message: 「Presumably, attacks weakened their strength as vessels until they collapsed」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel is the strongest vessel in history, so he won't collapse. Everything will be fine」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank goodness...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ahem. Though it is strange for us to be worrying about Re-Crea's host」
Truthfully, it might be better for the world if Azel ended up just like the previous hosts.
Still, it seemed Melilot and I felt the same way.

name: Melilot
message: 「A-Anyway. At this point in time, it is impossible to forcibly tear Re-Crea away from the outside」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, even with the method the Student Council chose... the odds of saving the world are roughly the same as if you attacked him」

name: Melilot
message: 「The force field Re-Crea generates is powerful, after all. Even landing an attack in the first place is doubtful」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if the odds are roughly the same, there is actual precedent of a Demon Lord defeating the host」

name: Synn
message: 「Even without a track record, if the chances of success are the same, I'll choose the path that saves both the world and Azel」
Melilot averted her gaze from me.

name: Melilot
message: 「This Re-Crea is the worst yet. Even as a mere natural phenomenon, it rivals the Re-Crea from the time of the first Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「The first Demon Lord's?」

name: Melilot
message: 「This is also the first time Demons and angels have joined forces to scheme behind the scenes」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that true!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Schemes happen all the time, sure, but angels and demons don't get along, so they never joined hands」

name: Paqy
message: 「There was even a Demon Lord who was dirt-weak, yet prevented a crisis by making their factions tear each other apart」

name: Melilot
message: 「On top of that, the strongest Vessel... the being we call God may truly be intending to destroy the world」

name: Synn
message: 「...I have one big question」

name: Melilot
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「What could Virus's goal be?」

name: Melilot
message: 「In the past. It would be the ambition that possessed countless mighty demons」

name: Synn
message: 「An invasion of Heaven?」

name: Paqy
message: 「There were plenty of fools like that. The stronger a demon is, the more they crave battle」

name: Synn
message: 「So he needed to trigger Re-Crea...?」
Melilot nodded.

name: Melilot
message: 「As the most heinous and ruthless warrior, all he desires is battle. That is what it means」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though given that everything will be destroyed, such a grand war could never possibly happen」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's nothing rare in history. Just a pathetic battle maniac dancing to God's tune」

name: Synn
message: 「In other words... Virus either doesn't know that Re-Crea means total destruction, or doesn't believe it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I believe that is the case」

name: Paqy
message: 「Maniacs only ever believe what they want to believe」
Is that really true?
Would a man like that come up with an unconventional scheme like joining forces with angels?
Though maybe he's simply throwing all caution to the wind.

name: Synn
message: 「I want to find out」

name: Melilot
message: 「Find out... what?」

name: Synn
message: 「His true intentions」

name: Paqy
message: 「Like I said, the guy's just a battle maniac」

name: Synn
message: 「Who confirmed that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「...I see. That's just the kind of guy you are, Lord Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「If he doesn't know, I think we should tell him.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That Re-Crea means destruction, you mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「If he finds that out, he might change his mind.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...And what if he already knows?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I want to know why he's trying to trigger Re-Crea. If I don't know, I can't do anything.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not even grant his wish.」
After staring intently at my face, Melilot murmured.

name: Melilot
message: 「To you, Sakura-kun, Virus is no different from the Demons who come to this world to play around, cause trouble, or end up in a bind.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that weird?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No. You may seem unsuited to be a Demon King, Sakura-kun, yet you are a truly splendid one.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Was that a compliment?

name: Melilot
message: 「It is recorded that even the First Demon King, the greatest Demon King in history, always sought to learn his opponent's wish before fighting, and always avoided any battle that could be avoided.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn's old man was the exact same way.」

name: Synn
message: 「Dad was...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It may be possible to get in touch with him. I have a lead.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please do.」

name: Melilot
message: 「To be honest, I'm rather reluctant... but it can't be helped.」
